name: Each Uisge
source:
Noel Richards is a young executive with DAC, a construction and development conglomerate.
He's also having an affair with his co-worker Susan, who accompanies him to a remote island where DAC is building a holiday resort.
However, the locals have a bizarre legend, and a poor opinion of the resort development, and sinister things are afoot...

[from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=4931&st=0&sk=t&sd=a]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
Noel Richards是建筑开发企业集团DAC的一名年轻主管。
他还与同事Susan保持着婚外情。Susan陪他前往一座偏远岛屿，DAC正在那里建设度假村。
然而，当地人流传着一个离奇传说，也对度假村开发颇为反感，而某些邪恶之事正在暗中酝酿…

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=4931&st=0&sk=t&sd=a]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
